name: AI-Assisted Coding
title: AI-Assisted Coding Master Curriculum
description: A comprehensive, interview-oriented, progressive learning curriculum teaching developers how to effectively use AI assistants for code generation, debugging, testing, refactoring, architecture, and agentic workflows.

sections.title: Section 1 — Introduction to AI Coding
sections.description: Master the fundamentals of AI coding assistants, LLM code models, capabilities, limitations, and essential workflow patterns.

lessons.title: What is AI-Assisted Coding?
objectives: Understand core capabilities of AI coding assistants.
Differentiate completion, chat, and agentic modalities.
Adopt AI as a high-speed junior pair programmer.

content.text: Understanding AI-Assisted Coding

AI-assisted coding leverages Large Language Models trained on open-source and enterprise repositories to assist software engineers in generating code, explaining logic, debugging stack traces, and writing unit tests.

steps.title: Developer Intent
steps.description: Define requirements, architecture, constraints, and edge cases.

steps.title: AI Generation
steps.description: Synthesize candidate solution based on prompt & context.

steps.title: Verification & Test
steps.description: Inspect, compile, unit test, and integrate change.

content.title: Senior Tech Lead Mindset
content.text: Treat the AI model as an energetic junior developer. Always review, test, and verify before merging into main.

keyTakeaways: AI augments human developers, it does not replace accountability.
Verification through compiler checks and unit tests is mandatory.

lessons.title: How AI Coding Assistants Work
objectives: Understand tokenization, context windows, and next-token prediction.
Learn why AI models do not execute code during generation.

content.text: Under the Hood of Code LLMs
LLMs predict next tokens probabilistically based on surrounding context. They do not run compiler or type checks unless provided tools.

content.title: Context Window Limits
content.text: Missing interfaces or package exports in context lead directly to hallucinated function signatures.

keyTakeaways: AI output is probabilistic next-token generation.
Provide relevant interfaces and types in prompt context.

lessons.title: AI vs Traditional Programming
objectives: Compare deterministic logic vs probabilistic generation.
Identify when to prompt vs write code manually.

content.text: Imperative Logic vs AI Specifications

content.title: Manual Code vs AI Specification
content.leftCode: function active(users: User[]) { return users.filter(u => u.active); }
content.rightCode: Generate a TypeScript function 'active' that filters active Users. Require immutability and unit tests.

keyTakeaways: Use manual coding for critical business rules; use AI for boilerplate and test suites.

lessons.title: Benefits of AI-Assisted Development
objectives: Quantify velocity improvements in boilerplate, docs, and testing.

content.text: AI accelerates repetitive coding tasks by up to 10x, enabling developers to focus on architectural design and system safety.

keyTakeaways: Redirect saved boilerplate time into testing and system safety.

lessons.title: Limitations of AI Coding
objectives: Spot hallucinated libraries, stale syntax, and insecure defaults.

content.title: Common AI Traps
content.text: Insecure default SQL strings, missing input sanitization, and deprecated library methods.

keyTakeaways: Verify library existence on npm/PyPI before importing.

lessons.title: AI Coding Workflow
objectives: Master the 5-step workflow: Specify -> Prompt -> Inspect -> Test -> Refine.

content.text: Work incrementally function by function, keeping diffs small and easily testable.

keyTakeaways: Small incremental steps prevent compounding hallucination errors.

lessons.title: Human Reasoning + AI Assistance
objectives: Combine developer intuition with AI generation speed.

content.text: Human judgment defines constraints and evaluates trade-offs; AI executes the typing and boilerplate.

keyTakeaways: Humans own the architecture and domain logic.

lessons.title: Common Mistakes Beginners Make
objectives: Avoid blind copy-pasting, huge single prompts, and ignoring linter errors.

items.text: Asking AI to write an entire complex system in 1 prompt

keyTakeaways: Understand every line of code committed to your repository.

sections.title: Section 2 — Prompt Engineering for Coding
sections.description: Master structured prompting techniques: Context + Goal + Constraints + I/O + Format to generate correct code on the first attempt.

lessons.title: What Makes a Good Coding Prompt?
objectives: Learn the universal prompt structure.
Eliminate ambiguous vocabulary in instructions.

content.text: Universal Coding Prompt Architecture
Structure prompts with: Context + Goal + Constraints + Input/Output + Format.

content.title: Weak vs Strong Prompt
content.strongPrompt: You are working on Node.js + TypeScript Express app. Write async handleLogin(req, res) validating req.body with Zod, querying Mongo user, comparing password with bcrypt, and returning JWT token with 200 JSON or 401 on failure.

keyTakeaways: State tech stack, exact parameters, constraints, and error handling rules explicitly.

lessons.title: Giving AI Proper Context
objectives: Supply interface definitions, schemas, and file snippets.

content.text: Paste relevant TypeScript interfaces and schemas prior to asking for function implementations.

keyTakeaways: Context quality determines code generation accuracy.

lessons.title: Defining Requirements Clearly
objectives: Translate feature specs into explicit prompt instructions.

content.text: Specify whether functions should be pure, asynchronous, or immutable.

keyTakeaways: Explicit specifications remove guesswork.

lessons.title: Specifying Input and Output
objectives: Use Few-Shot prompting with concrete input/output examples.

content.text: Providing 1 or 2 concrete input/output examples prevents subtle string/array transformations errors.

keyTakeaways: Few-shot examples clarify edge cases immediately.

lessons.title: Constraints and Edge Cases
objectives: Set time/space complexity bounds and zero-dependency rules.

content.text: State asymptotic time complexity bounds (e.g. O(n) time, O(1) space) in the prompt.

keyTakeaways: Bound the solution space with explicit constraints.

lessons.title: Asking for Step-by-Step Reasoning
objectives: Apply Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting for algorithms.

content.text: Instructing the model to "think step-by-step before writing code" drastically reduces algorithmic bugs.

keyTakeaways: Chain-of-thought prompting improves complex logic outputs.

lessons.title: Asking for Multiple Approaches
objectives: Request 2-3 alternative algorithms with trade-offs.

content.text: Compare brute-force, iterative, and dynamic programming options before selecting the optimal approach.

keyTakeaways: Evaluate trade-offs between memory, speed, and readability.

lessons.title: Asking AI to Review Its Own Code
objectives: Use reflection prompts to catch self-generated edge case failures.

content.text: Ask: "Review the code above. Are there any edge cases or null pointer risks where it fails?"

keyTakeaways: Reflection prompts catch subtle boundary bugs.

lessons.title: Iterative Prompting
objectives: Build features iteratively across conversational turns.

content.text: Build components in stages: Types -> Core Logic -> Error Handling -> Tests.

keyTakeaways: Keep prompt turns focused on small incremental additions.

lessons.title: Prompt Refinement
objectives: Diagnose and fix prompt specification errors.

content.text: When AI code fails, update the prompt with missing types or negative constraints rather than repeating the same prompt.

keyTakeaways: Fix the prompt specification when AI output deviates.

lessons.title: Common Bad Coding Prompts
objectives: Identify vague prompts and transform them into precise requests.

rows: No stack, no endpoints, no schemas
Write an Express + TypeScript POST /api/orders endpoint using Zod schema for validation.

keyTakeaways: Avoid single-sentence vague prompts.

lessons.title: Prompt Templates for Developers
objectives: Use standardized prompt templates for daily engineering tasks.

content.title: Standard Generation Template
content.code:
[ROLE]
You are a senior {{STACK}} engineer.

[GOAL]
Write a function {{NAME}} that {{PURPOSE}}.

[TYPES]
{{PASTE_TYPES}}

[CONSTRAINTS]
- Complexity: {{COMPLEXITY}}
- Handling: Return standard Result/Option or throw TypedError.

keyTakeaways: Use reusable prompt templates for consistent code quality.

sections.title: Section 3 — AI for Code Generation
sections.description: Practical generation across functions, classes, APIs, databases, React components, and backend microservices.

lessons.title: Generate a Function
objectives: Generate pure, typed utility functions with boundary validation.

content.title: Pure Formatter Function

keyTakeaways: Require explicit parameter and return types.

lessons.title: Generate a Class
objectives: Generate OOP classes following SOLID principles.

content.text: Generate encapsulated classes with private fields and interface injection.

keyTakeaways: Enforce private/protected field visibility.

lessons.title: Generate an API
objectives: Generate RESTful endpoints with Zod payload validation.

content.title: Express + Zod Route Handler

keyTakeaways: Validate HTTP request bodies with Zod or Joi schemas.

lessons.title: Generate Database Queries
objectives: Generate safe, parameterized SQL and ORM queries.

content.title: Injection Risk
content.text: Never allow AI to concatenate raw strings into SQL. Always use parameter bindings.

keyTakeaways: Verify parameterized SQL bindings.

lessons.title: Generate React Components
objectives: Generate accessible React components with Tailwind CSS.

content.text: Specify Props interfaces, local hooks, accessibility ARIA tags, and loading states.

keyTakeaways: Require explicit loading and error component states.

lessons.title: Generate Backend Services
objectives: Generate domain service layers decoupled from HTTP transport.

content.text: Decouple core business logic from Express/Fastify request objects.

keyTakeaways: Keep route handlers slim by generating service modules.

lessons.title: Generate Utility Functions
objectives: Generate stateless data manipulation utilities.

content.text: Generate pure utilities paired with automated unit tests.

keyTakeaways: Stateless utilities are perfect candidates for AI generation.

lessons.title: Generate Tests
objectives: Generate unit tests covering happy paths, edge cases, and errors.

content.text: Pass source code to AI and request Jest/Vitest test suites.

keyTakeaways: Verify that generated test cases pass when run.

lessons.title: Generate Configuration
objectives: Generate Dockerfiles and GitHub Actions workflows safely.

content.text: Inspect generated Dockerfiles to ensure non-root execution.

keyTakeaways: Never execute container applications as root.

lessons.title: Generate Complete Features
objectives: Orchestrate full-stack features incrementally layer by layer.

content.text: Build features sequentially: DB schema -> Service -> API -> UI -> Test.

keyTakeaways: Avoid single massive prompts for full-stack features.

sections.title: Section 4 — AI for DSA
sections.description: Use AI to understand DSA problems, generate brute-force vs optimized solutions, analyze Big-O complexities, and practice for interviews.

lessons.title: Using AI to Understand a DSA Problem
objectives: Ask AI to explain core algorithmic patterns conceptually before writing code.

content.text: Prompt AI to explain sliding window, two pointer, or graph traversal patterns without revealing code first.

keyTakeaways: Grasp the conceptual intuition before generating code.

lessons.title: Generate Brute Force Solution
objectives: Generate baseline brute-force solutions to establish correct behavior.

content.text: Brute force solutions provide an unoptimized reference baseline for verification.

keyTakeaways: Brute force provides a working test oracle.

lessons.title: Generate Optimized Solution
objectives: Optimize O(n²) algorithms to O(n) or O(n log n).

content.title: Brute Force O(n²) vs Hash Map O(n)

keyTakeaways: Hash Maps trade O(n) space for O(n) time performance.

lessons.title: Compare Multiple Approaches
objectives: Compare recursion vs DP vs iterative state.

content.text: Request comparison matrices evaluating time, space, and stack risks.

keyTakeaways: Evaluate memory stack limitations for deep recursion.

lessons.title: Complexity Analysis
objectives: Derive Big-O time and space bounds.

content.title: Hidden Operations
content.text: Array.shift() or string concatenation inside loops add implicit O(n) factors.

keyTakeaways: Derive best, worst, and average Big-O complexity.

lessons.title: Generate Test Cases
objectives: Generate adversarial edge cases to catch boundary errors.

content.text: Test empty collections, single items, negative values, and duplicates.

keyTakeaways: Adversarial test inputs expose loop boundary bugs.

lessons.title: Debug DSA Solutions
objectives: Fix off-by-one errors and pointer increment bugs.

content.text: Pass failing input and expected output to AI to trace variable state.

keyTakeaways: Provide exact failing test inputs to AI.

lessons.title: Find Edge Cases
objectives: Detect integer overflow and null root pointers.

content.text: Check mid = low + (high - low) / 2 to avoid integer overflow.

keyTakeaways: Check for integer overflow in binary search algorithms.

lessons.title: Optimize Time Complexity
objectives: Use Heaps, Tries, and Binary Search to reduce time complexity.

content.text: Replace linear scans with indexed binary search or map lookups.

keyTakeaways: Data structure choice dictates time complexity bounds.

lessons.title: Optimize Space Complexity
objectives: Reduce O(n) DP space to O(1) rolling state variables.

content.text: Store only required recent states instead of full DP matrices.

keyTakeaways: Optimize space by retaining only required state variables.

lessons.title: Use AI Without Losing Problem-Solving Ability
objectives: Use Socratic progressive hints during interview practice.

steps.title: Level 1
steps.description: High level conceptual pattern hint.

steps.title: Level 2
steps.description: Data structure choice hint.

steps.title: Level 3
steps.description: Pseudocode outline.

steps.title: Level 4
steps.description: Full code implementation.

keyTakeaways: Request Socratic hints to build personal problem-solving strength.

sections.title: Section 5 — AI for Debugging
sections.description: Master stack trace diagnosis, error message resolution, logical bug fixing, and minimal reproducible example techniques.

lessons.title: Giving AI an Error Message
objectives: Pass error text, failing snippet, and expected behavior.

content.title: Debugging Prompt
content.code:
[ERROR]
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
[CODE]
function renderList(items?: Item[]) { return items.map(i => i.id); }
[FIX REQUEST]
Add optional chaining and default fallback array.

keyTakeaways: Pass exact error text + failing code + expected outcome.

lessons.title: Giving AI a Stack Trace
objectives: Highlight top application frame in framework stack traces.

content.text: Locate the origin file frame in your application codebase.

keyTakeaways: Focus on the first non-framework stack frame.

lessons.title: Debugging Compilation Errors
objectives: Fix TypeScript compiler type mismatches.

content.text: Provide type definitions alongside the TS error code.

keyTakeaways: Provide full interface context to resolve type errors.

lessons.title: Debugging Runtime Errors
objectives: Fix NullPointer, TypeError, and Segfault crashes.

content.text: Introduce null guards, optional chaining, and defensive assertions.

keyTakeaways: Add defensive guards to eliminate runtime crashes.

lessons.title: Debugging Logical Errors
objectives: Fix silent bugs where output deviates from spec.

content.text: Pass input, actual output, and expected output to trace variable state.

keyTakeaways: Compare actual vs expected output state changes.

lessons.title: Debugging Wrong Answers
objectives: Fix failing test cases in algorithm problems.

content.text: Pass minimal failing test inputs to locate off-by-one errors.

keyTakeaways: Isolate the smallest failing test case.

lessons.title: Debugging Performance Issues
objectives: Fix CPU bottlenecks and event loop blocking.

content.text: Replace nested loops and synchronous I/O on main thread.

keyTakeaways: Eliminate synchronous blocking operations.

lessons.title: Debugging Memory Problems
objectives: Fix memory leaks and uncleaned event listeners.

content.text: Clean up timers, subscriptions, and unbounded cache objects.

keyTakeaways: Always provide cleanup functions in subscriptions.

lessons.title: Debugging With Minimal Reproduction
objectives: Strip framework noise to create 15-line MRE prompts.

content.text: Isolate the bug into a minimal reproducible example.

keyTakeaways: Minimal code produces maximum AI accuracy.

lessons.title: AI-Assisted Root Cause Analysis
objectives: Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and write regression tests.

content.text: Fix the underlying structural flaw and add a unit test.

keyTakeaways: Write regression tests for every resolved bug.

sections.title: Section 6 — AI Code Review
sections.description: Use AI to detect bugs, code smells, readability, maintainability, security risks, and error handling oversights.

lessons.title: What is AI Code Review?
objectives: Use AI as an automated static code reviewer.

content.text: AI code review inspects pull requests for bugs, security risks, and naming consistency.

keyTakeaways: AI code review complements human code review.

lessons.title: Finding Bugs
objectives: Spot unhandled promises, null pointers, and race conditions.

content.text: Prompt AI to audit code specifically for unhandled async rejections.

keyTakeaways: Audit async code for missing try/catch blocks.

lessons.title: Finding Code Smells
objectives: Detect long methods, deeply nested loops, and magic numbers.

content.text: Identify functions exceeding 30 lines or 3 levels of nesting.

keyTakeaways: Extract deeply nested blocks into named helper functions.

lessons.title: Checking Readability
objectives: Improve variable naming and reduce cognitive complexity.

content.text: Replace single-letter variables with domain-descriptive names.

keyTakeaways: Descriptive names improve codebase maintainability.

lessons.title: Checking Maintainability
objectives: Check coupling, cohesion, and SOLID compliance.

content.text: Ensure modules adhere to Single Responsibility principle.

keyTakeaways: Decouple module dependencies via interfaces.

lessons.title: Checking Security
objectives: Scan for SQL injection, XSS, and hardcoded secrets.

content.title: Security Audit
content.text: Prompt AI specifically: "Audit this handler for SQL injection, XSS, and hardcoded credentials."

keyTakeaways: Always conduct explicit security review prompts.

lessons.title: Checking Performance
objectives: Spot N+1 queries, unindexed filters, and memory leaks.

content.text: Check database ORM queries for missing eager-loading includes.

keyTakeaways: Prevent N+1 database queries during code review.

lessons.title: Checking Error Handling
objectives: Audit empty catch blocks and unhandled promise rejections.

content.text: Flag empty catch (e) {} blocks in pull requests.

keyTakeaways: Never silently swallow exceptions in catch blocks.

lessons.title: Reviewing Generated Code
objectives: Inspect AI-generated code with critical developer eyes.

content.text: Verify that AI-generated code matches team conventions.

keyTakeaways: Inspect AI-generated code as strictly as human PRs.

lessons.title: Creating a Code Review Checklist
objectives: Build automated AI code review prompt checklists.

items.text: Are all inputs validated with a schema?

keyTakeaways: Standardize code review criteria into a prompt checklist.

sections.title: Section 7 — AI for Refactoring
sections.description: Refactor legacy code, extract functions, eliminate duplication, simplify complex conditionals, and verify zero behavioral shifts.

lessons.title: What is Refactoring?
objectives: Improve internal code structure without altering external behavior.

content.text: Refactoring cleans technical debt while keeping tests passing.

keyTakeaways: Refactoring alters internal structure without changing behavior.

lessons.title: Extracting Functions
objectives: Break 100-line monolithic methods into single-purpose helpers.

content.text: Prompt AI: "Extract nested loops into pure helper functions."

keyTakeaways: Keep function body sizes small and focused.

lessons.title: Removing Duplication
objectives: Apply DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle.

content.text: Consolidate duplicate logic into shared utility modules.

keyTakeaways: Eliminate duplicated business logic.

lessons.title: Improving Naming
objectives: Rename cryptic variables to clear domain terminology.

content.text: Replace ambiguous flags with descriptive boolean predicates.

keyTakeaways: Use clear domain language for variable names.

lessons.title: Simplifying Complex Logic
objectives: Replace nested if-else ladders with guard clauses and lookup maps.

content.title: Nested Ifs vs Early Return Guard Clauses

keyTakeaways: Use early returns to flatten nested conditional logic.

lessons.title: Improving Architecture
objectives: Migrate procedural code to clean layer architecture.

content.text: Decouple presentation, application, and persistence layers.

keyTakeaways: Separate business logic from persistence frameworks.

lessons.title: Refactoring Legacy Code
objectives: Modernize legacy JavaScript to typed TypeScript.

content.text: Add strict interfaces and types to legacy untyped JS files.

keyTakeaways: Add TypeScript types to legacy JavaScript files.

lessons.title: Refactoring Without Changing Behavior
objectives: Preserve external behavior contracts using unit tests.

content.text: Run unit test suite before and after every refactoring step.

keyTakeaways: Green tests prove refactoring preserved behavior.

lessons.title: Test-First Refactoring
objectives: Write characterization tests prior to refactoring legacy code.

content.text: Generate test cases covering existing code before touching implementation.

keyTakeaways: Write characterization tests before refactoring legacy code.

lessons.title: Verifying AI Refactoring
objectives: Diff changes carefully to spot accidental behavior shifts.

content.text: Review git diffs line-by-line to verify no logic was omitted.

keyTakeaways: Inspect git diffs carefully for omitted logic.

content.title: Generated Unit Test

lessons.title: Validation

sections.title: Section 11 — AI for Databases
sections.description: Generate, explain, and optimize SQL queries, schema design, relationships, indexes, transactions, normalization, and migrations.

lessons.title: Generate SQL
objectives: Generate ANSI SQL queries with joins, aggregations, and CTEs.

content.title: SQL Aggregation Query
content.code:
SELECT u.id, u.email, COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.total_cents) AS lifetime_value
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY u.id, u.email
HAVING SUM(o.total_cents) > 10000
ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC;

keyTakeaways: Use CTEs (Common Table Expressions) to simplify complex SQL queries.

lessons.title: Explain SQL
objectives: Analyze EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution plans with AI assistance.

content.text: Identify Sequential Scans vs Index Scans in EXPLAIN output.

keyTakeaways: Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to verify index utilization.

lessons.title: Optimize Queries

lessons.title: Database Schema Design

objectives: Implement ACID database transactions with isolation levels.

keyTakeaways: Wrap multi-table mutations in atomic transactions.

sections.title: Section 12 — AI Hallucination & Verification
sections.description: Detect hallucinated APIs, nonexistent packages, incorrect algorithm assumptions, and master the GENERATE -> INSPECT -> TEST -> VERIFY -> INTEGRATE pipeline.

lessons.title: What is AI Hallucination?
objectives: Understand why LLMs generate plausibly-formatted incorrect code.

content.text: Hallucinations occur when an LLM predicts tokens that look statistically valid but do not correspond to real runtime modules.

keyTakeaways: Plausible-looking code can still be entirely hallucinated.

lessons.title: Why AI Generates Incorrect Code
objectives: Recognize training data noise, knowledge cutoff, and context limits.

content.text: LLMs lack compiler execution feedback during token generation.

keyTakeaways: Token prediction does not validate runtime module exports.

lessons.title: Detecting Incorrect APIs
objectives: Spot invented function names and parameters in generated code.

content.text: Verify method signatures against official framework documentation.

keyTakeaways: Check API method names against official documentation.

lessons.title: Detecting Nonexistent Libraries
objectives: Prevent Slopsquatting security hazards from hallucinated packages.

content.title: Slopsquatting Security Risk
content.text: Attackers register package names hallucinated by AI to distribute malware. Always check npm/PyPI before running npm install.

keyTakeaways: Never install unknown packages without checking registry existence.

lessons.title: Detecting Incorrect Documentation Claims
objectives: Cross-check AI text claims against code execution.

content.text: Verify that AI explanation text matches actual code behavior.

keyTakeaways: Verify that explanation text matches code execution.

lessons.title: Detecting Incorrect Algorithms
objectives: Catch subtle logic bugs in AI-generated algorithms.

content.text: Run edge-case test inputs through a debugger or trace log.

keyTakeaways: Execute unit tests to detect algorithmic flaws.

lessons.title: Verifying Dependencies
objectives: Audit package dependencies for version compatibility.

content.text: Verify package version support in package.json.

keyTakeaways: Confirm dependency versions match installed packages.

lessons.title: Verifying Security Claims
objectives: Conduct independent security verification on AI code.

content.text: Run static analysis security tools (SAST) on AI code.

keyTakeaways: Run SAST security scanners on generated code.

lessons.title: Verifying Performance Claims
objectives: Benchmark AI performance claims with actual timers.

content.text: Measure actual execution runtime using performance.now().

keyTakeaways: Benchmark AI performance claims with actual timers.

lessons.title: Never Trust Generated Code Blindly
objectives: Master the 5-step verification rule: GENERATE -> INSPECT -> TEST -> VERIFY -> INTEGRATE.

steps.title: GENERATE
steps.description: Prompt AI for initial implementation draft.

steps.title: INSPECT
steps.description: Read line-by-line and check types.

steps.title: TEST
steps.description: Run compiler, linter, and unit tests.

steps.title: VERIFY
steps.description: Verify security and performance bounds.

steps.title: INTEGRATE
steps.description: Commit change to git version control.

keyTakeaways: Adhere strictly to GENERATE -> INSPECT -> TEST -> VERIFY -> INTEGRATE.

sections.title: Section 13 — AI Security
sections.description: Audit AI-generated code for SQL injection, XSS, authentication mistakes, secret exposure, unsafe dependencies, and input validation vulnerabilities.

lessons.title: Security Risks of AI-Generated Code
objectives: Identify top security flaws in AI generated code.

content.title: Insecure Defaults
content.text: AI models frequently output insecure defaults (e.g. CORS *, plain text HTTP, disabled SSL).

keyTakeaways: AI models favor simple code over secure code by default.

lessons.title: SQL Injection
objectives: Detect and fix string concatenation SQL injection in AI code.

content.title: Insecure String SQL vs Secure Parameterized SQL

keyTakeaways: Enforce parameter bindings on all database query strings.

lessons.title: XSS
objectives: Prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in generated UI components.

content.text: Avoid innerHTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML without DOMPurify sanitization.

keyTakeaways: Sanitize user input before rendering dynamic HTML.

lessons.title: Authentication Mistakes
objectives: Spot insecure JWT secret storage and weak password hashing.

content.text: Store JWT secrets in environment variables, never in source code.

keyTakeaways: Never hardcode JWT signing secrets in source files.

lessons.title: Authorization Mistakes
objectives: Fix Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR).

content.text: Verify user ownership (e.g. record.userId === req.user.id) on resource lookup.

keyTakeaways: Verify user ownership on every database record lookup.

lessons.title: Secret Exposure
objectives: Prevent API keys and private keys from leaking into prompts or code.

content.text: Use .env file variables and git secret scanners.

keyTakeaways: Never paste production API secrets into AI prompts.

lessons.title: Unsafe Dependencies
objectives: Audit third-party package vulnerabilities with npm audit.

content.text: Run npm audit to scan generated dependencies for CVE vulnerabilities.

keyTakeaways: Run npm audit after adding new AI-suggested packages.

lessons.title: Input Validation
objectives: Enforce strict Zod schema validation on all API endpoints.

content.text: Reject unexpected payload properties using Zod .strict().

keyTakeaways: Use Zod schemas to sanitize all incoming HTTP request data.

lessons.title: Secure API Design
objectives: Configure Helmet security headers and CORS origin restrictions.

content.text: Apply Helmet security response headers to Express servers.

keyTakeaways: Apply security response headers on every API backend.

lessons.title: Security Review of AI Code
objectives: Conduct dedicated security code review prompts before merging.

content.text: Prompt AI: "Perform an OWASP Top 10 security review on this backend file."

keyTakeaways: Run explicit OWASP security review prompts on new code.

steps.title: PLAN
steps.description: Decompose task into tool invocation steps.

content.text: Capstone Scenario: E-Commerce Checkout System

In this capstone, you will build a production-grade REST API endpoint for Order Checkout with JWT authentication, inventory check, database transaction, input validation, unit tests, and OpenAPI documentation.

steps.title: Requirement
steps.description: Define user checkout spec & error codes.

steps.title: Type Schema
steps.description: Write Zod validation & DTO types.

steps.title: DB Schema
steps.description: Define Drizzle ORM order tables.

steps.title: Service Logic
steps.description: Generate checkout service with transaction.

steps.title: API Handler
steps.description: Build Express POST /api/checkout route.

steps.title: Unit Tests
steps.description: Generate Jest unit & integration tests.

steps.title: Security Audit
steps.description: Perform OWASP Top 10 security prompt review.

steps.title: Optimization
steps.description: Benchmark query timing & add Redis lock.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.description: Generate JSDoc and OpenAPI 3.0 YAML.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: Run full CI test suite & verify build.

content.title: Step 1: Generated Checkout Service Layer

keyTakeaways: The complete AI workflow combines specification, incremental generation, unit testing, security review, and performance benchmarking.
Always use database transactions when modifying inventory or multi-table state.
Human developers lead the architecture while AI accelerates the implementation.
